_comment: Copy to ~/.dynbrain/config.json. One file per person: the tasks run in the owner's own session, with the owner's own connectors.
_cadences_note: Which scheduled tasks this person gets. `harvest` is per-person (role author). `canon` and `queue` are corpus-wide (role steward) and belong on ONE machine, or one per territory — an article owner receives the Monday notice as a mail.activity without installing anything. Absent means all three.
_novelties_note: Article id of the `01 · Novedades` node. The setup resolves it through the ORM proxy; null means the runs resolve by name and stop if ambiguous.

servers._comment: MCP server names as they appear in this person's session (the part between mcp__ and __tool). Identified by tool family, never assumed.
